% A \thechapter set in the preamble of a scrbook document: lettered
% chapters, with a section and an equation numbered within them, and
% references to each with hyperref.
\documentclass{scrbook}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\renewcommand*\thechapter{\Alph{chapter}}
\begin{document}
\chapter{Start}\label{start}
\section{Basics}\label{basics}
\begin{equation}
x = 1 \label{eq}
\end{equation}
Ref: \ref{start}; \ref{basics}; (\ref{eq}); \ref{second}.
\chapter{Second}\label{second}
Here \ref{second}.
\end{document}
